That weapew wiww kiww us if you don't take out its minions! .⁰(☒д☒ₒ )⁰.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 21 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Reaper''' was a summoner [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It has one ability; it periodically swings it scythe forwards into the ground to summon random enemies. At its debut, it can spawn the [[Invisible]] or [[Hefty]], though it can begin to spawn the [[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]] or [[Fallen]] starting from wave 25 or the [[Lava]] starting from wave 38. The '''Fallen Reaper''' has an average amount of health for its debut and moves at an average speed. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], which prevents the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] from completely stopping it, instead slowing it down and prevents it from being knocked back. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Reaper''' is similar to the [[Dark Necromancer]], but it does not have legs. Instead, it floats slightly above the path. It has reflective black skin, a dark black marble jacket with grey skull shoulder pads with neon purple eyes and a dark grey dominus. A dark purple chain is wrapped around its torso. It wields a neon purple scythe that can summon enemies. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Deal with this enemy as soon as possible before its summons threaten your defenses. *From wave 25, if the '''Fallen Reaper''' is left unattended, it will start to spawn [[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]]s which can increase the firerate of your towers, making them shoot slower. **They can also spawn [[Fallen]]s which are very quick and may outrun your towers. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]], can deal with the '''Fallen Reaper'''. **You may want to set their targeting to ''Strongest'' to ignore the summoned enemies, though this may be risky. *The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Sledger]] can be quite useful at slowing this down. They can also deal a decent amount of damage to both the '''Fallen Reaper''' and the enemies it spawns. **Do note that stunning towers like the [[Warden]] cannot stop it completely due to its [[Stun Immunity]], slowing it down instead. Additionally, this immunity also makes it immune to knockback. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] can be effective against the '''Fallen Reaper''' and the enemies it summons. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FallenReaper.png|First version, first animation (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenReaper.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexFallenReaper.png|'''Fallen Reaper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Fallen Reaper's''' scythe is very similar to the [[Molten Boss]]'s scythe, except that it is colored purple. *The '''Fallen Reaper''' could be considered the [[Fallen]] version of the [[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]]. *The '''Fallen Reaper''' is the only way for the [[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]] to appear in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **The '''Fallen Reaper''' can also spawn [[Fallen]]s way before its debut wave (46) in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Fallen Reaper''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Animation changed. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''30 April 2025''' - [[v1.63.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Fallen Reaper''' no longer uses the death sound effect. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Fallen Reaper''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Void Reaper]]. Now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Mega Slow]]|Wave 19|Fallen Reaper|Wave 21|[[Shadow Boss]]|Wave 23|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
